draft.subject: Jyoti Ceramic's export enquiries online
draft.body:
Hello,

Jyoti Ceramic exports 70% of its production to over 55 countries. That is a wide set of buyers who likely find you through search before they ever request a quote.

When I looked at the site, I noticed there is no Organization schema or other structured data, and the buyer FAQ is only one question. That makes it harder for search engines and AI tools to describe the business correctly to overseas buyers.

At node6 Labs we build websites, stores and automation, and fixing this is a small project.

Would you be open to a short note on what I would change?

Mitull
